method: Read every original page and compare every keyed target form/gloss plus all41 parenthetical comparison records. Enlarged targeted crops used for leṭî, jhâtkarîti, ûrê and luluâm. One scratch crop overwritten; immutable original images retained.
source_scope: Crooke glossary ends after naked on p128 above the rule; Driver’s separate article/table is outside this source. Intro reports one Hindi-speaking Korwa informant from southern Mirzapur, with casual Hislop Kuri/Muâsi comparison and explicit deferral of linguistic analysis. Do not infer donor/cognacy links.

records.finding: Clear compact underdot directly beneath italic t. Root literal reading omitted this source mark.

typed_uncertainty.observation: A very small compact speck occurs just beneath the final m, visibly smaller than the secure underdot of leṭî. Image alone does not securely establish intentional diacritic versus blemish.
typed_uncertainty.disposition: Preserve provisional plain m only with this explicit mark evidence and uncertainty. Do not assert securely plain m or infer a phonetic distinction.

records.targeted_resolution: Enlarged original shows the two-stroke u body beneath the circumflex; ûrê supported, rather than an inferred form or a t-initial word.

records.finding: The i after r has a clear circumflex; the final vowel is a dotted i, not u. Both distinctions are visible on the original.

records.source_inconsistency: The sentence prints plain-t leti; retain separately from p125 leṭî. No analogical regularization.
